title: "SoCO Journal Club · DAROMUN Pulse"
description: "Adaptive pre-meeting pulse for the SoCO Journal Club discussion of DAROMUN / PIVOTAL."
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    toc: false
    title-block-banner: false
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow,noarchive">
        <meta name="googlebot" content="noindex,nofollow,noarchive">
---

```{=html}

<style>
#quarto-header,
.navbar,
.quarto-navbar-tools,
footer,
.nav-footer,
.page-footer,
#quarto-content > .page-columns > .content > header,
#title-block-header,
.quarto-title-block,
h1.title {
  display: none !important;
}

body,
#quarto-content,
.page-columns,
.content,
main.content {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

#quarto-content {
  min-height: 100vh !important;
}
</style>

<style>
:root{
  --ink:#102a35;
  --muted:#667980;
  --paper:#f4f8f7;
  --card:#ffffff;
  --line:#d8e5e2;
  --accent:#1f7475;
  --accent2:#3d928f;
  --soft:#e4f2f0;
  --radius:24px;
  --shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(16,42,53,.10);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink)}
body{
  font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 12% -10%,rgba(31,116,117,.12),transparent 28rem),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#fbfdfc 0%,#f3f8f7 100%);
}
button{font:inherit}
.shell{
  min-height:100dvh;
  width:min(100%,720px);
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) 16px max(22px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
}
.topbar{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-start;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  margin-bottom:18px;
}
.brand .eyebrow{
  font-size:.72rem;
  font-weight:850;
  letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--accent);
  margin-bottom:4px;
}
.brand .title{
  font-size:clamp(1.08rem,4vw,1.35rem);
  font-weight:820;
  letter-spacing:-.025em;
}
.dev{
  appearance:none;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);
  color:var(--muted);
  border-radius:999px;
  padding:7px 10px;
  font-size:.72rem;
  font-weight:760;
  cursor:pointer;
}
.screen{
  flex:1;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  justify-content:center;
  min-height:0;
}
.card{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);
  border:1px solid rgba(216,229,226,.95);
  border-radius:var(--radius);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  padding:clamp(22px,5vw,34px);
}
.kicker{
  font-size:.74rem;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--accent);
  margin-bottom:9px;
}
h1,h2,p{margin-top:0}
h1,h2{
  letter-spacing:-.035em;
  line-height:1.06;
}
h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,8vw,3.15rem);margin-bottom:14px}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.65rem,7vw,2.55rem);margin-bottom:13px}
.lede{
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:clamp(1rem,4.1vw,1.16rem);
  line-height:1.48;
  margin-bottom:20px;
}
.prompt{
  font-size:clamp(1.18rem,5vw,1.48rem);
  font-weight:820;
  line-height:1.25;
  letter-spacing:-.02em;
  margin-bottom:16px;
}
.choice-stack{display:grid;gap:10px}
.choice{
  width:100%;
  text-align:left;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:#fff;
  color:var(--ink);
  border-radius:16px;
  padding:15px 16px;
  font-weight:780;
  line-height:1.2;
  cursor:pointer;
  box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(16,42,53,.04);
}
/* Do not visually highlight answer buttons merely because a stationary pointer
   happens to be over them after a screen transition. That can look like a
   preselected response. Preserve a clear keyboard-only focus treatment. */
.choice:focus-visible{
  border-color:rgba(31,116,117,.55);
  background:var(--soft);
  outline:3px solid rgba(31,116,117,.18);
  outline-offset:2px;
}
.note{
  margin:15px 2px 0;
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:.9rem;
  line-height:1.4;
}
.primer{
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f8fbfa,#eef7f5);
  border-radius:18px;
  padding:15px 16px;
  margin:3px 0 18px;
}
.primer .mini{
  font-size:.69rem;
  letter-spacing:.11em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--accent);
  font-weight:900;
  margin-bottom:6px;
}
.primer p{
  margin:0;
  font-size:.96rem;
  line-height:1.45;
}
.cta{
  appearance:none;
  border:0;
  width:100%;
  border-radius:16px;
  padding:16px 17px;
  background:var(--accent);
  color:white;
  font-weight:850;
  font-size:1rem;
  cursor:pointer;
}
.cta:hover,.cta:focus-visible{
  background:var(--accent2);
  outline:3px solid rgba(31,116,117,.2);
  outline-offset:3px;
}
.meta{
  margin-top:12px;
  color:var(--muted);
  text-align:center;
  font-size:.76rem;
}
.progress{
  display:flex;
  gap:5px;
  margin:0 0 16px;
}
.progress span{
  height:4px;
  flex:1;
  border-radius:99px;
  background:var(--line);
}
.progress span.on{background:var(--accent)}
.evidence .choice{
  padding:13px 15px;
}


.text-input{
  width:100%;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:#fff;
  color:var(--ink);
  border-radius:15px;
  padding:13px 14px;
  font:inherit;
  font-size:1rem;
  box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(16,42,53,.035);
}
.text-input:focus{
  outline:3px solid rgba(31,116,117,.18);
  border-color:rgba(31,116,117,.55);
}
.text-area{
  resize:vertical;
  min-height:88px;
  margin-bottom:15px;
}
.field-label{
  font-weight:850;
  margin-top:2px;
}
.field-label span{
  font-weight:650;
  color:var(--muted);
}
.receipt-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr;
  gap:10px;
  margin-top:18px;
}
.receipt-grid > div{
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fbfdfc,#f4f9f8);
  border-radius:15px;
  padding:12px 14px;
}
.receipt-grid small{
  display:block;
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:.7rem;
  font-weight:850;
  letter-spacing:.09em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-bottom:4px;
}
.receipt-grid strong{
  display:block;
  line-height:1.3;
}

.role-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:10px;
}
.role-choice{
  min-height:56px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:flex-start;
}
@media (max-width:430px){
  .role-grid{gap:8px}
  .role-choice{
    min-height:52px;
    padding:12px 13px;
    font-size:.94rem;
  }
}

@media (max-height:720px){
  .shell{padding-top:12px;padding-bottom:12px}
  .topbar{margin-bottom:10px}
  .card{padding:19px}
  .lede{margin-bottom:14px}
  .choice-stack{gap:8px}
  .choice{padding:12px 14px}
  .primer{padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:14px}
}
</style>


<div class="shell">
  <div class="topbar">
    <div class="brand">
      <div class="eyebrow">SoCO Journal Club</div>
      <div class="title">DAROMUN · PIVOTAL</div>
    </div>
    <button class="dev" id="resetBtn" title="Return to the familiarity question">Start over</button>
  </div>

  <!-- Static Netlify survey form: named fields must exist in built HTML. -->
  <form id="survey-form"
        name="daromun-pre-jc-survey-v3"
        method="POST"
        action="/"
        data-netlify="true"
        netlify-honeypot="bot-field"
        style="display:none">
    <input type="hidden" name="form-name" value="daromun-pre-jc-survey-v3">
    <input type="hidden" name="survey_id" value="soco-daromun-pulse-2026">
    <input type="hidden" name="survey_version" value="3.0">
    <input type="hidden" name="respondent_id" id="respondent_id">
    <input type="hidden" name="campaign" id="campaign">
    <input type="hidden" name="entry_familiarity" id="entry_familiarity">
    <input type="hidden" name="started_at_client" id="started_at_client">
    <input type="hidden" name="completed_at_client" id="completed_at_client">
    <input type="hidden" name="elapsed_seconds" id="elapsed_seconds">

    <input type="hidden" name="familiarity" id="familiarity">
    <input type="hidden" name="evidence_compelling" id="evidence_compelling">
    <input type="hidden" name="clinical_scenario" id="clinical_scenario">
    <input type="hidden" name="discussion_priority" id="discussion_priority">
    <input type="hidden" name="adcom_evaluable_meaningful" id="adcom_evaluable_meaningful">
    <input type="hidden" name="primary_role" id="primary_role">
    <input type="hidden" name="question_for_room" id="question_for_room">
    <input type="hidden" name="name" id="name_final">

    <label>Do not fill this out
      <input name="bot-field" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off">
    </label>
  </form>

  <!-- Separate anonymous funnel form. No page-load event is ever posted. -->
  <form id="event-form"
        name="daromun-pulse-events-v3"
        method="POST"
        action="/"
        data-netlify="true"
        netlify-honeypot="event-bot-field"
        style="display:none">
    <input type="hidden" name="form-name" value="daromun-pulse-events-v3">
    <input type="hidden" name="event_name">
    <input type="hidden" name="respondent_id">
    <input type="hidden" name="campaign">
    <input type="hidden" name="entry_familiarity">
    <input type="hidden" name="event_at_client">
    <input type="hidden" name="step">
    <label>Do not fill this out
      <input name="event-bot-field" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off">
    </label>
  </form>

  <main class="screen" id="screen"></main>
</div>

<script>
const screen = document.getElementById("screen");
const resetBtn = document.getElementById("resetBtn");
const surveyForm = document.getElementById("survey-form");

const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const entryFamiliarity = params.get("familiarity") || "";
const campaignValue = params.get("campaign") || "";

const RESPONDENT_KEY = "soco_daromun_v3_respondent_id";
let humanStartedTracked = false;
let familiarityChoice = ["none","basics","data"].includes(entryFamiliarity) ? entryFamiliarity : "";
let evidenceChoice = null;
let scenarioChoice = null;
let discussionChoice = null;
let adcomChoice = null;
let roleChoice = null;

const copy = {
  none: {
    kicker: "YOUR STARTING POINT",
    title: "Perfect. That’s useful to know.",
    lede: "You do not need to know this paper yet. That’s part of the point.",
    primer: "DAROMUN combines two tumor-targeted immunocytokines delivered intralesionally before surgery and was studied in the phase III PIVOTAL trial.",
    cta: "Got it — give me the question →"
  },
  basics: {
    kicker: "YOUR STARTING POINT",
    title: "Great. You have enough context to have an initial take.",
    lede: "We’ll keep the background light and get quickly to where you land.",
    primer: null,
    cta: "Let’s get into it →"
  },
  data: {
    kicker: "YOUR STARTING POINT",
    title: "Got it. Let’s go straight to the evidence.",
    lede: "We’re interested in your starting interpretation before the room weighs in.",
    primer: null,
    cta: "Let’s get into it →"
  }
};

function isLocalPreview(){
  return location.protocol === "file:" ||
         location.hostname === "localhost" ||
         location.hostname === "127.0.0.1";
}

function makeId(){
  if (window.crypto && crypto.randomUUID) return crypto.randomUUID();
  return "soco-" + Date.now().toString(36) + "-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
}

function respondentId(){
  let id = "";
  try { id = localStorage.getItem(RESPONDENT_KEY) || ""; } catch (_) {}
  if (!id) {
    id = makeId();
    try { localStorage.setItem(RESPONDENT_KEY, id); } catch (_) {}
  }
  return id;
}

function setHidden(id, value){
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (el) el.value = value == null ? "" : String(value);
}

function ensureStarted(){
  let t = document.getElementById("started_at_client").value;
  if (!t) {
    t = new Date().toISOString();
    setHidden("started_at_client", t);
  }
  return t;
}

function syncCoreHidden(){
  setHidden("respondent_id", respondentId());
  setHidden("campaign", campaignValue);
  setHidden("entry_familiarity", entryFamiliarity);
  setHidden("familiarity", familiarityChoice);
  setHidden("evidence_compelling", evidenceChoice);
  setHidden("clinical_scenario", scenarioChoice);
  setHidden("discussion_priority", discussionChoice);
  setHidden("adcom_evaluable_meaningful", adcomChoice);
  setHidden("primary_role", roleChoice);
}

function encode(data){
  return new URLSearchParams(data).toString();
}

async function trackEvent(eventName, step){
  // Scanner safety: this function is called only after a deliberate human action.
  // It is never called merely because the URL loaded.
  const data = {
    "form-name": "daromun-pulse-events-v3",
    event_name: eventName,
    respondent_id: respondentId(),
    campaign: campaignValue,
    entry_familiarity: familiarityChoice || entryFamiliarity || "",
    event_at_client: new Date().toISOString(),
    step: step || ""
  };

  if (isLocalPreview()) return;

  try {
    await fetch("/", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
      body: encode(data),
      keepalive: true
    });
  } catch (_) {
    // Funnel telemetry must never interrupt survey completion.
  }
}

function markHumanStarted(step){
  ensureStarted();
  syncCoreHidden();
  if (humanStartedTracked) return;
  humanStartedTracked = true;
  trackEvent("human_started", step);
}

function setParam(value){
  const u = new URL(window.location.href);
  u.searchParams.set("familiarity", value);
  history.replaceState({}, "", u);
}

function clearParam(){
  const u = new URL(window.location.href);
  u.searchParams.delete("familiarity");
  history.replaceState({}, "", u);
}

function renderGateway(){
  clearParam();
  screen.innerHTML = `
    <section class="card">
      <div class="kicker">LOCAL PROTOTYPE · EMAIL GATEWAY</div>
      <h1>Before the room weighs in</h1>
      <div class="prompt">How familiar are you with DAROMUN / PIVOTAL?</div>
      <div class="choice-stack">
        <button class="choice" data-f="none">→ Not familiar yet</button>
        <button class="choice" data-f="basics">→ Familiar with the basics</button>
        <button class="choice" data-f="data">→ Familiar with the data</button>
      </div>
      <div class="note"><em>Any starting point is useful.</em></div>
      <div class="meta">Choose one to begin</div>
    </section>
  `;
  screen.querySelectorAll("[data-f]").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      familiarityChoice = btn.dataset.f;
      setParam(familiarityChoice);
      syncCoreHidden();
      markHumanStarted("familiarity_selected_on_site");
      renderLanding(familiarityChoice);
    });
  });
}

function renderLanding(f){
  const x = copy[f] || copy.none;
  screen.innerHTML = `
    <section class="card">
      <div class="progress"><span class="on"></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
      <div class="kicker">${x.kicker}</div>
      <h2>${x.title}</h2>
      <p class="lede">${x.lede}</p>
      ${x.primer ? `
        <div class="primer">
          <div class="mini">The 20-second version</div>
          <p>${x.primer}</p>
        </div>` : ""}
      <button class="cta" id="continueBtn">${x.cta}</button>
      <div class="meta">Your response is not submitted until the final screen</div>
    </section>
  `;
  document.getElementById("continueBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
    familiarityChoice = f;
    syncCoreHidden();
    markHumanStarted("adaptive_intro_continue");
    renderEvidence();
  });
}

function renderEvidence(){
  const answers = [
    "Very compelling",
    "Moderately compelling",
    "Interesting, but not yet practice-changing",
    "Not particularly compelling",
    "Unsure / need to understand the data better"
  ];

  screen.innerHTML = `
    <section class="card evidence">
      <div class="progress"><span class="on"></span><span class="on"></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
      <div class="kicker">YOUR STARTING POSITION</div>
      <h2>How compelling do you currently find the PIVOTAL evidence?</h2>
      <div class="choice-stack">
        ${answers.map(a => `<button class="choice" data-evidence="${a}">${a}</button>`).join("")}
      </div>
      <div class="meta">Your pre-discussion starting position</div>
    </section>
  `;

  screen.querySelectorAll("[data-evidence]").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      evidenceChoice = btn.dataset.evidence;
      syncCoreHidden();
      trackEvent("evidence_answered", "evidence");
      renderScenario();
    });
  });
}

function renderScenario(){
  const scenarioAnswers = [
    "DAROMUN → surgery",
    "Neoadjuvant systemic immunotherapy → surgery",
    "Upfront surgery",
    "RP1 + nivolumab (when available)",
    "I’d need more information before deciding"
  ];

  screen.innerHTML = `
    <section class="card">
      <div class="progress"><span class="on"></span><span class="on"></span><span class="on"></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
      <div class="kicker">A PATIENT IN FRONT OF YOU</div>
      <p class="lede" style="color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:16px">
        Resectable, injectable locoregional recurrence after prior surgery and adjuvant anti–PD-1.
        No distant disease. Assume DAROMUN is available.
      </p>
      <h2 style="font-size:clamp(1.55rem,6vw,2.25rem)">What would you be most likely to recommend?</h2>
      <div class="choice-stack">
        ${scenarioAnswers.map(a => `<button class="choice" data-scenario="${a}">${a}</button>`).join("")}
      </div>
      <div class="meta">Choose the option you would be most likely to recommend</div>
    </section>
  `;

  screen.querySelectorAll("[data-scenario]").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      scenarioChoice = btn.dataset.scenario;
      syncCoreHidden();
      trackEvent("scenario_answered", "clinical_scenario");
      renderDiscussionQuestion(scenarioChoice);
    });
  });
}

function renderDiscussionQuestion(scenarioChoice){
  const discussionAnswers = [
    "How DAROMUN compares with modern neoadjuvant systemic therapy",
    "Which patients are most likely to benefit, especially after prior anti–PD-1",
    "Whether benefit extends beyond the injected lesions",
    "How to interpret the endpoints and durability of benefit",
    "I need more context before deciding"
  ];

  screen.innerHTML = `
    <section class="card">
      <div class="progress"><span class="on"></span><span class="on"></span><span class="on"></span><span class="on"></span><span></span><span></span></div>
      <div class="kicker">WHAT DESERVES DISCUSSION?</div>
      <h2 style="font-size:clamp(1.55rem,6vw,2.25rem)">What question most needs discussion?</h2>
      <div class="choice-stack">
        ${discussionAnswers.map(a => `<button class="choice" data-discussion="${a}">${a}</button>`).join("")}
      </div>
      <div class="meta">Choose the issue that matters most to your interpretation right now</div>
    </section>
  `;

  screen.querySelectorAll("[data-discussion]").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      discussionChoice = btn.dataset.discussion;
      syncCoreHidden();
      renderAdcomQuestion(scenarioChoice, discussionChoice);
    });
  });
}

function renderAdcomQuestion(scenarioChoice, discussionChoice){
  const adcomAnswers = ["Yes", "No", "Unsure"];

  screen.innerHTML = `
    <section class="card">
      <div class="progress"><span class="on"></span><span class="on"></span><span class="on"></span><span class="on"></span><span class="on"></span><span></span></div>
      <div class="kicker">EVIDENCE INTERPRETATION</div>
      <h2>Are the PIVOTAL efficacy results evaluable and clinically meaningful?</h2>

      <div class="choice-stack" style="margin-top:18px">
        ${adcomAnswers.map(a => `<button class="choice" data-adcom="${a}" style="text-align:center;font-size:1.05rem">${a}</button>`).join("")}
      </div>

      <div class="note" style="margin-top:18px">
        <em>Adapted from the voting question posed at the July 2026 FDA CTGTAC meeting for RP1 + nivolumab in advanced melanoma.</em>
      </div>

      <div class="meta">Pre-discussion starting position</div>
    </section>
  `;

  screen.querySelectorAll("[data-adcom]").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      adcomChoice = btn.dataset.adcom;
      syncCoreHidden();
      renderRoleQuestion(
        scenarioChoice,
        discussionChoice,
        adcomChoice
      );
    });
  });
}

function renderRoleQuestion(scenarioChoice, discussionChoice, adcomChoice){
  const roles = [
    "Medical Oncology",
    "Dermatology / Dermatologic Surgery",
    "Surgery / ENT",
    "Radiation Oncology",
    "Pathology / Dermatopathology",
    "Research / Scientist",
    "Trainee",
    "Industry",
    "Other"
  ];

  screen.innerHTML = `
    <section class="card">
      <div class="progress"><span class="on"></span><span class="on"></span><span class="on"></span><span class="on"></span><span class="on"></span><span class="on"></span></div>
      <div class="kicker">WHO’S IN THE ROOM?</div>
      <h2 style="font-size:clamp(1.5rem,5.8vw,2.15rem)">What is your primary professional role?</h2>

      <div class="role-grid">
        ${roles.map(a => `<button class="choice role-choice" data-role="${a}">${a}</button>`).join("")}
      </div>

      <div class="meta">Context only — not another test</div>
    </section>
  `;

  screen.querySelectorAll("[data-role]").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      roleChoice = btn.dataset.role;
      syncCoreHidden();
      renderFinalContribution(
        scenarioChoice,
        discussionChoice,
        adcomChoice,
        roleChoice
      );
    });
  });
}

function renderFinalContribution(scenarioChoice, discussionChoice, adcomChoice, roleChoice){
  screen.innerHTML = `
    <section class="card">
      <div class="kicker">ONE QUESTION FOR THE ROOM</div>
      <h2 style="font-size:clamp(1.45rem,5.6vw,2.05rem);margin-bottom:10px">
        What do you most want the group—or the investigators—to address?
      </h2>
      <p class="note" style="margin:0 0 14px"><em>Optional. One sentence is plenty.</em></p>

      <textarea id="roomQuestion" class="text-input text-area"
        rows="3"
        placeholder="Your question or concern..."></textarea>

      <div class="field-label">Name <span>(optional)</span></div>
      <p class="note" style="margin:4px 0 9px"><em>Leave blank to stay anonymous.</em></p>
      <input id="nameField" class="text-input" type="text" autocomplete="name"
        placeholder="Your name">

      <button class="cta" id="submitBtn" style="margin-top:16px">
        Submit my starting position →
      </button>

      <div class="meta"><span id="submitStatus">Your response will be saved when you submit</span></div>
    </section>
  `;

  document.getElementById("submitBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
    submitSurvey({
      scenarioChoice,
      discussionChoice,
      adcomChoice,
      roleChoice
    });
  });
}

async function submitSurvey(x){
  const button = document.getElementById("submitBtn");
  const status = document.getElementById("submitStatus");
  const roomQuestion = document.getElementById("roomQuestion").value.trim();
  const name = document.getElementById("nameField").value.trim();

  setHidden("question_for_room", roomQuestion);
  setHidden("name_final", name);
  syncCoreHidden();

  const started = new Date(ensureStarted());
  const done = new Date();
  setHidden("completed_at_client", done.toISOString());
  setHidden(
    "elapsed_seconds",
    Number.isFinite(started.getTime()) ? Math.max(0, Math.round((done - started) / 1000)) : ""
  );

  button.disabled = true;
  button.textContent = "Saving…";
  status.textContent = isLocalPreview()
    ? "Local preview — simulating successful submission"
    : "Saving your starting position…";

  const data = new FormData(surveyForm);
  const body = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [k,v] of data.entries()) body.append(k, v);

  try {
    if (!isLocalPreview()) {
      const response = await fetch("/", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
        body: body.toString()
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Netlify returned " + response.status);
    }

    await trackEvent("survey_completed", "complete");

    renderReceipt({
      ...x,
      roomQuestion,
      name
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err);
    button.disabled = false;
    button.textContent = "Submit my starting position →";
    status.textContent = "We couldn’t save that yet. Please try once more.";
  }
}

function renderReceipt(x){
  const first = x.name ? x.name.split(/\s+/)[0] : "";
  const heading = first ? `Thanks, ${escapeHtml(first)}.` : "Your starting position is now part of the room.";

  screen.innerHTML = `
    <section class="card">
      <div class="kicker">YOU’RE IN.</div>
      <h2>${heading}</h2>
      <p class="lede">
        ${first ? "Your starting position is now part of the room. " : ""}
        We’ll open Journal Club with where everyone started—and see whether the discussion moves us.
      </p>

      <div class="receipt-grid">
        <div>
          <small>Evidence</small>
          <strong>${escapeHtml(evidenceChoice)}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <small>Clinical choice</small>
          <strong>${escapeHtml(x.scenarioChoice)}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <small>Evidence vote</small>
          <strong>${escapeHtml(x.adcomChoice)}</strong>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="meta" style="margin-top:18px">
        ${isLocalPreview()
          ? "Local preview complete · no data were transmitted"
          : "Response saved"}
      </div>
    </section>
  `;
}

function escapeHtml(value){
  return String(value || "")
    .replaceAll("&","&amp;")
    .replaceAll("<","&lt;")
    .replaceAll(">","&gt;")
    .replaceAll('"',"&quot;")
    .replaceAll("'","&#039;");
}

resetBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  evidenceChoice = null;
  scenarioChoice = null;
  discussionChoice = null;
  adcomChoice = null;
  roleChoice = null;
  familiarityChoice = "";
  syncCoreHidden();
  renderGateway();
});

syncCoreHidden();

const initial = ["none","basics","data"].includes(entryFamiliarity) ? entryFamiliarity : "";
if (initial) {
  familiarityChoice = initial;
  syncCoreHidden();
  renderLanding(initial);
} else {
  renderGateway();
}
</script>
```
